notes.title: More Typo Fixes (English & Chinese)
notes.content:
Hi! We've pushed out another few small typo fixes affecting the English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese translations.

English
We've corrected a few additional typos and missing words that users identified and kindly reported to us.

A flow discrepancy in Chapter 2
A typo in the Extra Chapter (DLC) Musubihime
Contextual adjustments to use the correct gender of fiancé/fiancée throughout


Chinese
We were notified of one misplaced line in both Chinese translations. This line has been corrected.

An erroneous line in Chapter 5


Many thanks to the users on our Discord server and elsewhere who brought these issues to our attention!

notes.title: Typo Fixes (English & Chinese)
notes.content:
Hi! We've pushed out some minor typo fixes affecting the English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese translations.

English
We've corrected a few typos and missing words that users have identified and kindly reported to us so far.

A missing "a" early in Chapter 1
A missing "me" in Chapter 2
A typo in Chapter 3
A missing "know" in Chapter 8
A wording tweak for grammatical agreement in Chapter 11


Chinese
A few lines were accidentally duplicated or incorrectly inserted. These lines have been corrected.

A duplicated line in Chapter 4
Two duplicated lines in Chapter 11
A line insertion error in Chapter 11 that led to a number of lines being played with incorrect voices 


Many thanks to the users on our Discord server and elsewhere who brought these issues to our attention!
